ASH GIANT SLAYER
CR 16

XP 76,800
Ash giant slayer 5
CN Large humanoid (giant)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 10, flat-footed 25 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +10 natural, –1 size)
hp 228 (19 HD; 14d8+5d10+138)
Fort +20, Ref +10, Will +6
Defensive Abilities rock catching; Immune disease, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee greataxe +26/+21/+16 (4d6+18/x3 plus disease) or 2 slams +21 (1d8+6 plus disease)
Ranged cannon +16 (6d6/x4 plus disease) or throwing axe +10 (1d8+12 plus disease) or rock +13 (1d8+18 plus disease)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks disease, rock throwing (120 feet), sneak attack +1d6 +1 bleed, studied target +2 (2nd, move action)

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 14, Con 25, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +15; CMB +28; CMD 40
Feats Catch Off-guard, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Power Attack, Precise Shot, Self-Sufficient, Siege Engineer, Sliding Axe Throw
Skills Climb +12, Heal +12, Intimidate +22, Knowledge (engineering) +6, Perception +14, Stealth +14, Survival +23
Languages Common, Giant
SQ oversized weapon, slayer talents (bleeding attack +1, deadly range), track +2, wild empathy +14
Gear breastplate, cannon, greataxe, throwing axe (7), selection of razors and knives in a giant scalp holder.
